cucumber.pointConvention: Top-origin image pixel-edge grid: occupied alpha>=threshold pixel box is [L,T,R,B), and bottom-rim support is midpoint of occupied pixel run on bottommost qualifying row at the outside bottom edge, ((rowL+rowR)/2,B). Coordinates are edges, not pixel centers. UV uses bottom-origin v=1-y/H. Use alpha>=128 primary; 64/192 sensitivity is descriptive, not three selectable mappings.
cucumber.sensitivity64And192: Frozen proposal retained as descriptive sensitivity; not alternative mappings.
